name: Christian Jobelius Schulz
bio: I am a PhD student in Econometrics at the University of Duisburg-Essen. I am part of the Ruhr Graduate School in Economics and a member of the TRR 391. I worked in the monetary policy department of the Deutsche Bundesbank and I am currently visiting the monetary policy directorate of the Bank of England as a PhD intern. I co-organize the Ruhr Metrics Reading Group. My research focuses on (time series) econometrics, machine learning, and forecasting for (macro-)finance and energy.
